//: Throwaway warm-up session run once right after the local bundle is installed into a fresh scratch profile. DSH activation is async: the very first headless session after an install can build its first request before the plugin has attached (observed: request/header #1 offered 0 confluence tools, the next step offered all 6). The warm-up absorbs that cold start so the acceptance sessions measure the product contract, not activation timing. Distinct final text so it is never confused with an acceptance session.

default.text: Warm-up session completed; no tools were needed.

responses.text: Warm-up session completed; no tools were needed.
